snippet.description:

STREAM NOW ▶ https://cg5.lnk.to/RaceToWin

Song by @CG5
Animation by @ItsTME, @elvitt0ri0, & @FUCH_official
Car Models by kiiikoshi (https://x.com/kiiikoshi)
Character Models by @zayJax, @coolioart9341, & @GabeTheWaffle

Twitter ▶ http://twitter.com/cg5beats

Spotify ▶ https://sptfy.com/cg5_
Instagram ▶ http://www.instagram.com/cg5beats/

Follow @cg5instrumentals, @cg5live105, & @cg5covers107
Discord Server ▶ https://discord.gg/CG5

LYRICS:

I don't want the pain,
I want to be okay.
But I can feel my mind,
Slip away from time.
But I won't crash,
Or brace.
Go faster I don’t race to lose.
I can't lose, I can't lose.

I drift away sometimes, (sometimes)
Fear what I feel inside again.
And when the fearing's interfering,
I'm persevering through the feeling.
And revealing a way that I can get up,
Get up, get up.

This is our race to win.
This is our race to win.

Driven mad to the brim,
Call the Reaper, things look grim,
I’m drifting out, drifting in,
Drifting deeper into sin.
Start again, start again.
Put the key in the ignition.
Cuz we ain’t done with (been feignin’ for) this mission.
Pedal to the metal, play to win.
I seek the finish line,
Speed up, I won’t resign again.

And when the fearing's interfering,
I'm persevering through the feeling.
And revealing a way that I can get up,
Get up, get up, get up.

This is our race to win.
This is our race to win.

Lyrics:

Wake up in the morning
Tell me that you’re all in
Then we go for days where we don’t speak
Why’d you let me fall hard
Now I’m in the graveyard 
Praying that the flowers are for me

All my inner demons
Mix up with my feelings
When I think you’re leaving
Up in my mind
I can wake my bad side
When I think that we’ve died

So don’t go ghostin’ on me,
Ghostin’ on me
(I’ll make your life a living hell)
Don’t go ghostin’ on me,
Ghostin’ on me
(You’ll get to know the devil well)
So don’t go ghostin’ on me

No halo,
She’s a fallen angel
Loving her is faithful
Losing her is fatal
So don’t go ghostin’ on me,
Ghostin’ on me

Pouring me a coffee
Tell me that you love me
Borrowing the lines you used last week
Run it like a poet
Shame you never show it
Struggle to believe the words you speak

All my inner demons
Mix up with my feelings
When I think you’re leaving
Up in my mind
I can wake my bad side
When I think that we’ve died
So don’t go ghostin’ on me,
Ghostin’ on me
(I’ll make your life a living hell)
Don’t go ghostin’ on me,
Ghostin’ on me
(You’ll get to know the devil well)
So don’t go ghostin’ on me

No halo,
She’s a fallen angel
Loving her is faithful
Losing her is fatal
So don’t go ghostin’ on me,
Ghostin’ on me

I don’t think you see 
My delicate hands 
Trace around your body
Spreading salt
And building walls
I’m forced to mark my territory X2

snippet.title: THE SKY BELOW | CONTROL Resonant Song feat. Cami-Cat
snippet.description:
CONTROL Resonant is available now for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC on Steam and the Epic Games Store! https://yrstru.ly/Stupes-Resonant

Well, you probably guessed this was coming. I am a HUGE fan of Remedy games, and after we made ‘Slide into the Void’ six years ago for Control, we HAD to do a follow-up for Control Resonant! Luckily the wonderful folks over at Remedy Games wanted to sponsor us again after our Alan Wake project ‘The Ribbon’, and here we are!
I’m very grateful, because their sponsorship meant we could go ALL OUT on this video. We have ALL the toys in this one: Armando our robot arm, a new (second-hand) super slow-mo camera, the smoke machine, the caustic light projector, prismatic lens filters, an air-compressor… and that’s just the gear! Did I mention we booked a rain studio and custom built TWO sets? AND ONE ROTATES? 
Yeah, the whole team worked super hard on this one. Every second is packed full of really cool stuff, I think it came out incredibly. I hope you think so too! Maybe take a second to look at all the lovely names in the credits below and appreciate them for their work!
Special thanks to the wonderful @Cami-Cat for jumping on this track and providing the vocals for Jesse’s character. We had to get her back on this one as she’s been on all of my other Remedy-verse songs! She knocks it out of the park every single time - go give her some love!

#ad #remedygames #controlresonant

snippet.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer Review
snippet.description:
Star Wars: Galactic Racer reviewed by Luke Reilly on Xbox Series X. Also available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series S, and PC.

"Star Wars: Galactic Racer is a fabulous looking and frantically fast anti-grav racer that impressively goes further than just taking the decades-old Star Wars Racer games and giving them a 4K facelift. With a range of satisfyingly customisable vehicle classes beyond podracers, a world outside the racing you can soak in and explore in third-person, and an interesting roguelite-adjacent structure that injects a considerable degree of risk into the action, Galactic Racer is a fresh and accomplished blend of Lucas lore with the destructive spirit of arcade racing icons like Burnout and MotorStorm. Its run-based campaign can grow unavoidably tedious over long stints because of its heavy reliance on repeatedly revisiting the same slim selection of planets, and its lack of splitscreen is disappointing considering its roots run back to consoles regarded as the kings of same-couch chaos. But Galactic Racer is an otherwise confident debut from developer Fuse Games, and one that has successfully lit the afterburners on a long-dormant slice of the Star Wars universe."
